title: Irrigation Log Form
subtitle: Irrigation record recurring events, evidence, variances, review decisions, escalation, and accountable period closeout in one operational record.
description: An original, workflow-complete irrigation operating log covering identity and routing, domain observations and evidence, accountable decisions, exceptions and escalation, and completion handoff without replacing qualified judgment.
use_case: Use for a defined operating period when staff need repeatable entries, traceable observations, visible exceptions, and a reviewed handoff. The record is owned by the irrigation operations owner and closes only after evidence, exceptions, disposition, and the next accountable handoff are documented.

sections.title: Irrigation log routing
sections.guidance: Define the period, owner, subject, and controlling identifiers.

blocks.label: Operating Log identity and routing
blocks.guidance: Assign one owner and use the same record ID in attachments and follow-up.

blocks.label: Irrigation Run Or Zone identity
blocks.guidance: Preserve the identifiers used by the controlling farm, facility, or partner record.

sections.title: Irrigation operating context
sections.guidance: Capture the baseline needed to interpret recurring entries.

blocks.label: Entry readiness and record controls
items: Source, pump, meter, and zone identity were recorded
Schedule or agronomic instruction reference was recorded
Starting and ending meter values were captured
Pressure, flow, and distribution observations were recorded
Filter, valve, emitter, or sprinkler condition was noted
Runoff, ponding, leaks, or blocked areas were identified
Weather, rainfall, and soil or crop context was noted
Variance, shutdown, and follow-up ownership were recorded
blocks.guidance: Use these confirmations at the start of the log period and revisit changed conditions.

sections.title: Irrigation recurring entries
sections.guidance: Record each event with enough evidence to reconstruct what occurred.

blocks.label: Irrigation event log
blocks.guidance: Use one row per distinct event; continue under a linked record when more rows are needed.

blocks.label: Trend, context, and supporting evidence notes

sections.title: Irrigation period review and decision
sections.guidance: Review completeness, trends, and work that cannot be closed.

blocks.label: Review evidence
items: Irrigation entries, dates, and identifiers reconcile
Trends and abnormal events are supported by recorded evidence
Open exceptions have an owner and due point
Restrictions or holds are visible to the next operator
Qualified review was obtained where the controlling procedure requires it

blocks.label: Decision rationale, trend interpretation, and next action

sections.title: Irrigation exceptions and escalation
sections.guidance: Make incomplete or abnormal events visible until disposition.

blocks.label: Stop, hold, and authority boundary
blocks.guidance: This record supports irrigation operations but does not set agronomic, water-quality, electrical, backflow, or injection requirements. Stop and route abnormal conditions to the qualified owner under current site procedures.

blocks.label: Irrigation exception triggers
items: Source, meter, pump, or zone identity mismatch
Pressure, flow, volume, or run-time variance
Leak, blockage, runoff, ponding, or distribution gap
Sensor, controller, valve, or alarm failure
Water-quality, backflow, or injection concern
Allocation, access, crop instruction, or repair authority gap
blocks.guidance: Mark each applicable trigger and explain any uncertainty in the exception record.

blocks.label: Irrigation unresolved-event register
blocks.guidance: Do not close a row until its disposition and accountable owner are explicit.

sections.title: Irrigation log closeout and handoff
sections.guidance: Reconcile the period and transfer remaining work.

blocks.label: Irrigation open actions and limitations
blocks.guidance: Carry forward every item that is not fully resolved at closeout.

blocks.label: Irrigation handoff confirmations
items: Irrigation entries and period totals were reconciled
Corrections and exception records retain accountable owners
Restrictions, holds, or service needs were transferred
Next log period or review point was assigned
Source records and supporting evidence were filed
blocks.guidance: Unchecked items remain part of the open handoff.

blocks.label: Final outcome, remaining limits, communications, and acceptance notes
